newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt electric firm ups H1 96/7 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt electric firm ups H1 96/7 profit.

text.p: Egypt's Elmaco/Nasr Electric Transformers and Equipment raised net distributable profits for the first half of financial 1996/7 to 5.0 million ($1.47 million) pounds from 3.83 million for the same year ago period, the official figures published on Wednesday showed.
The financial year ends on June 30.
Net sales for the first six months of 1996/7 were also higher at 61.22 million from 57.12 million in the same period of 1995/6.

As part of its privatisation programme, the Egyptian state sold its majority stake in Elmaco to a local consortium which groups Egemac (Egyptian German Electrical Manufacturing Company) and another unidentified firm.
But the state's power distribution companies own a majority stake in Egemac and Germany's Siemens is a minority shareholder.
